name: Compare Protein Structures
description: Compares two protein structures to identify structural differences and conformational changes.
detailed_description: Compares two protein structures to identify structural differences and conformational changes.
when_to_use: When you need compare protein structures analysis

parameters.pdb_file1: [Required] Path to the first PDB file (str)

parameters.chain_id1: [Optional] Chain ID to analyze in the first structure (default: A)
